details:
I have an idea to expand onto the Groups system, that allows groups and communities to create a customized or automatic "Level up" system for members and participants. Level up from 1 to 100 (or beyond).

==Suggested criteria for leveling==

-Time spent in instances

-Representing the group banner

-Making friends in group instances, or adding group mutuals

Optional:

-VRC+ gifts in group instances to others

-CE purchases or gifts to others in eligible worlds, groups, communities

-Discord linking? Server/account/roles

==Visibility==

Defaults: Leveling needs to be enabled by the group owner or administrator. When leveling is enabled for the group, members will begin leveling up, but only the group member can see their personal level without oversight from other members or admins. Notifications for leveling, and EXP adjustment is disabled by default, unless enabled locally for that group by the group member.

Other visibility options: Members can later choose to 'share'/'display'/'show' their group level publicly, with group members, or with friends only. Group administration can participate in a "Leaderboard" which can be enabled or initiated by the group owner. When level sharing is enabled, members can also choose to share their level when representing the group banner on their nameplate.

==Settings==

Roles: Group organizers can make it so that a member can automatically switch custom roles when reaching a certain level. Example: Level 1 starts you as Group Initiate set as a custom role, level 5 switches your role to Group Member as a custom role, Level 10 switches to Advanced Group Member, et. al.

Administration: Enabling the leveling system, enabling the leaderboard, leveling criteria, level cap (1-100 is default, but could go to 1000), adjusting EXP or levels for individual users

Members: Sharing levels, sharing levels when representing group banner, participating in the leaderboard, toggling notifications for leveling and EXP adjustment, leaving then rejoining a group at a later time will keep level persistence
title: Groups "Level up" system
